subject: general
question: Six people are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. P sits second to the left of Q. S is an immediate neighbour of both Q and U. T sits second to the left of R. Who is the immediate neighbour of both P and U?
solution:
**Given: **Six people are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

P sits second to the left of Q.

S is an immediate neighbour of both Q and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13a1fde1504ff0678c810065e367aec6125a3cf34351423bc2838a49a4948cb.png] 

T sits second to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d953bb8d2aac4feb213ec7a9d718165c61559dfcca2f6345a7ce6f1f02d385d0.png] 

So, **T **is the immediate neighbour of both P and U.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 1'.***
